source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: What uncertainty and provenance details are visible in a multi-laboratory smFRET benchmark, and can the current candidate family evaluate them?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Hellenkamp et al. (2018), Precision and accuracy of single-molecule FRET measurements-a multi-laboratory benchmark study, Nature Methods.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: 20-laboratory benchmark, FRET efficiency dispersion, correction procedure, and conversion uncertainty.

source_objects.native_observable: Intensity-based single-molecule FRET efficiency measurements for dye-labeled DNA duplex standards.

source_objects.statistical_unit: Measurements contributed by 20 laboratories on specified dye-labeled standards.
source_objects.spatial_support: Dye-pair distances and FRET efficiency in the specified standards.

source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: The source reports uncertainty and reproducibility evidence but does not map them into a generic project reliability score.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract describes a comparative blind study across 20 laboratories and reports FRET-efficiency dispersion.
The abstract discusses correction and distance-conversion uncertainty/procedures.

The SOURCE binding, candidate-map-only dependency, HUMAN_OR_NEW_DATA route, unresolved status, and prohibition on generic reliability conclusions are internally consistent with the dossier and its evidence ceiling.
